# Pollard's Precision Parts

> Custom 3D-printed replacement, discontinued, and hard-to-find parts, made by Chris Pollard in a Llano, Texas (Hill Country) workshop. Materials: PLA, PETG, ASA, TPU. Not for load-bearing, electrical, stove, or child-safety parts.

- [Home](https://pollardprecisionparts.com/): what gets made
- [Services](https://pollardprecisionparts.com/services.html): how orders work and materials
- [Contact](https://pollardprecisionparts.com/contact.html): pollardprecisionparts@gmail.com

Requests by email: pollardprecisionparts@gmail.com. Include a photo, the make/model it fits, rough measurements, and quantity. A person reviews every request; nothing is a commitment until Chris confirms it.
